title: One Division Bench cannot disagree with another coordinate Bench and revisit settled issue: Madras HC
description: The Madras High Court has held that one Division Bench cannot disagree with the reasoning of another coordinate Bench and take a fresh view on an issue already settled by it [D Paramasivam v. P Arunachalam and another].A Bench of Justices GR Swaminathan and V Lakshminarayanan said that an earlier judgment by a Bench of equal strength remains binding unless it is overruled by a larger Bench or reversed by the Supreme Court.“It is not open to one Division Bench to hold that they do not agree with
